strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
So this is the enemy's heart... Let's hope we drew the right spot...
The atmosphere's composition... is almost the same as Earth's, huh.
It really does feel like a plant planet.
Why would something like this...
What is this asteroid, anyway?
I imagined something more like a barren hunk of rock...
A beautiful world, full of nature. ...Yet we've come to destroy it...
Yes, it would've been fine if it were only full of nature.
Rom, are we maybe trying to do something wrong?
Having a heart that loves nature is important.
But... if something must be sacrificed for it... we've no choice but to fight.
That's what fighting is... Dad used to say that too, right, Sis?
...Yeah.
All the more so when it's an unjust invasion. Even if I'm not keen on it.
But we can't just sit back and watch.
Uraki's right.
We have to protect ourselves on our own. ...And our homeworld, too.
To do that... we need to find the core quickly.
I hope we can get through this smoothly...
Hm!?
I knew it...! Looks like they're on to our moves!
Quite the welcome. There's even a new model we've never seen.
The enemy's not that easy!
So you've come this far... No mercy to those who hinder the Dirad's dream!
That Dancougar doesn't seem to be here... but you'll be first!
The Dirad's dream!? What's your goal... What is this dream!
Taking root... Heh heh heh.
I'd love to let you watch your world become food for our Dirad...
but I cannot forgive you for defiling the land of the Dirad!
Taking root? I don't know what that means, but!
In the end, it's still an invasion!
Then we can't back down either!
Your bravado ends here...!
Here they come! Master Rom!
Heaven, earth, fire, water... grant us your power...!
Londo Bell, are you all right!?
What...! Letting an enemy battleship get in! What is Abel doing!
Heh... I never thought the Gandor would come. Much obliged.
Sorry we're late. The Gandor unit will now provide support!
Huh, it's actually a pretty nice place.
Don't be fooled by looks, Koji!
Oh, it's actually pretty nice. I imagined something much creepier...
Don't be fooled by appearances, Jun.
What they're trying to do is as horrifying as it gets.
This lush, green nature... It may be the kind of scene Master wished for...
but this is nothing but false nature.
Domon...
Is this everyone here?
Yes... The Nadesico and the Mazinger team should be ahead. The rest...
Since we've already joined up...
only the core assault unit is left.
So our forces are concentrating again?
Leave the guys around here to us!
With the Zambot here, we're unstoppable!
This battle... do we see a chance of victory?
Making noise here won't get us anywhere. Let's go, Shinobu!
You got it! ...Sara, you get it, right? I know you want to rush out, but...
...Don't worry about me, Shinobu. I told you I'm over it, didn't I?
Let's just sortie. Whatever we do, it won't start till we head out.
That's... the Dancougar! Curses... so you survived...!
Same as always, lining up nothing but numbers!
I'll shoot down every last one of you!
If only... if only you weren't here, Lord Shapiro would...!
New models too. Just what you'd expect of the enemy's home base.
Captain, you're safe!
Of course we are!
Amuro and Kamille came too. Like we'd lose to stuff like that!
Lowly Earthlings...! Don't get cocky!
All right! Let's take 'em down!
The core still seems a ways off... No time to linger!
Damn... Reinforcements!
That blue robot! Don't tell me... here too!?
Ah... Lord Shapiro's mech...
Too bad it's not Shapiro... Keim.
Abel... I can handle this alone. You protect Lady Diore!
Would you say the same if it were Shapiro who came?
Hahahahaha...
New arrivals. And we're short on time...
Looks like they're fighting each other?
I don't know... What's going on?
Show, don't let your guard down!
Heh, if they're squabbling, all the better. I'll take 'em all out!
Isn't that the robot of that Shapiro guy from before?
Shapiro Keats... doesn't seem to be here...
A fake Dancougar showed up too...
It wouldn't be strange if Shapiro's mech were being mass-produced.
Calm down, Sara.
I am calm!
This is no time to be yapping!
Big Bro's right!
The Dirad people's long-held dream... I will see it fulfilled, no matter what!
Leave the rest to me and fall back, Keim.
Ngh, this is as far as I go...! Withdrawing for now!
Tch, he's running, that bastard!
Roll! Don't let him get away!
No need to pursue. We'll be fighting them again soon enough...
Right now, wiping out the enemies in front of us comes first.
They should be cornered, yet they pull back like this... Something's up...
Brother...?
We've only driven off their main force! Don't let your guard down!
You should have stayed quietly at Lady Diore's side.
Ngh... The time of taking root is near... Don't think this is over.
Hah, listen to the sore loser!
I hope that's all it is...
Taking root? What does that even mean...?
So this planet does mean to land on Earth... But for what?
Thinking about it won't get us anywhere!
All we have to do is destroy this lump!
Domon, isn't that a little too simple?
Whatever their reasons, no one needs to be sacrificed for them.
Well, that's about the size of it.
...New models? There's still more!?
Only two of them... but is this their secret weapon...?
They look... very strong. Shiro, numbers don't seem to matter here!
They look kind of like the Hyakki Empire mechs we fought on Earth.
But we should've taken down their fortress island...
Th-that's... It can't be...!? Hey, Hayato, Benkei!
Yeah, I noticed already, Ryo. ...That's...
You know it?
Gilgilgan... Wasn't that what we called it back then!?
The worst space monster ever, getting bigger by eating anything...
What the hell's it doing in a place like this!?
I heard about it from Tetsuya... But there was more than one of 'em!?
Yeah, that thing is... Tetsuya, you remember it!?
It's that worst-of-all space monster that eats anything and grows huge...!
I believe they called it Gilgilgan.
...Yes, Ryoma and the others and I fought one before...!
Tch, I thought we'd taken it out... So there was more than one!?
Hey, is that thing strong?
Strong enough, I'd say.
"Strong enough," huh...
It looks like this won't be easy.
Judging by how they talk about it, no.
It's like an old monster movie.
But why is it on this planet?
Save the questions for later! Destroying it is the top priority!
Well, that takes care of that for now.
So it seems. Londo Bell, I am of the Federation's Far East Branch,
Hazuki, Commander of the Cyber Beast Force.
An honor to meet you, Commander. I hear things were rough on Earth too.
Hey, hey! This is no time for friendly chitchat, Hazuki, old man!
We'll have to save the introductions for later.
The Commander's pretty uptight about that stuff.
Let's get everyone loaded onto the Gandor and move on!
Let's hurry.
If this asteroid hits Earth... there won't be time for talking!
Right now we need to hurry.
What a rush.
That's absolutely right. Let's go.
The Nadesico... I hope it made it to the core safely...
Let's not say anything ominous, but we can't be optimistic till we know.
Come on! You too, Amuro, and you too, Quattro!
Tch, it's no good if the grown-ups get scared.
With this much firepower gathered here, if it comes down to it...
Not all of us may make it, but... we'll have to be ready for anything.
Yeah... The Earth Sphere still isn't at peace...
...For now, all we can do is press on.
We finally joined up with the Gandor team, and it's already a mad rush.
Given the situation, what can you do?
